subject.title: Write tool lacks append mode — isolated cron sessions destroy shared files

question: Should OpenClaw accept `append?: boolean` on the existing write tool as the permanent append contract for ordinary agent, cron, and monitor workflows, or require a different append API before closing this issue?
rationale: The failure is source-reproducible, but the remaining fix becomes a public model-facing and extension-observable tool contract that automation should not approve without maintainer intent.

options.title: Accept append flag on write
options.body: Land the open implementation after maintainer review, keeping overwrite as the default and using `append: true` for safe accumulation.

options.title: Choose a different append contract
options.body: Ask for a replacement shape such as `mode: "append"` or a dedicated append tool before merging any public API.

options.title: Defer the code change
options.body: Keep the issue open and rely on backup or shell-redirect workarounds, accepting that ordinary write calls can still truncate shared files.

recommendation.title: Accept append flag on write
recommendation.body: Land the open implementation after maintainer review, keeping overwrite as the default and using `append: true` for safe accumulation.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is about the shared model-facing agent runtime write-tool contract, and current blame plus repository routing point to steipete as the strongest available owner signal.
